title: Iron reprogrammes the root system architecture by regulating OsWRKY71 in arsenic-stressed rice (Oryza sativa L.).
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铁与砷胁迫下水稻OsWRKY71转录因子对根系构型的调控，含分子对接验证OsWRKY71与SLR1互作，但核心是植物生理与基因表达，非TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: Iron (Fe) has been critically reported to act as a signal that can be interpreted to activate the molecular mechanisms involved in root developmental processes. Arsenic (As) is a well-known metalloid that restricts the growth and productivity of rice plants by altering their root architecture. Since root system architecture (RSA) under As stress targets WRKY transcription factors (TFs) and their interaction partners, the current investigation was carried out to better understand the Fe-dependent dynamics of RSA and its participation in this process. Here, we analyzed the effects of As and Fe (alone or in combination) exposed to hydroponically grown rice roots of 12-day-old plants. Our research showed that adding As to Fe changed how OsWRKY71 was expressed and improved the morphology and anatomy of the rice roots in Ratna and Lalat varieties. As + Fe treatment also manifested the biochemical parameters. OsWRKY71, revealed an up-regulation (Fe alone and As + Fe conditions) and down-regulation (As stress) in both varieties, in comparison to the controls. The improved root anatomy and root oxidizability indicated the enhanced capability of Lalat over the Ratna variety to induce OsWRKY71 for the better development of RSA during As + Fe treatment. Further, OsWRKY71 has revealed the presence of gibberellin-responsive cis-regulatory elements (GAREs) in its promoter region, indicating the involvement of OsWRKY71 in the gibberellin pathway. Molecular docking revealed that OsWRKY71 and SLR1 (DELLA protein) interact positively, which supports the hypothesis that Fe alters RSA by regulating OsWRKY71 through the gibberellin pathway in As-stressed rice.
abstract_zh: 铁（Fe）已被关键性地报道为一种信号，可被解读以激活参与根系发育过程的分子机制。砷（As）是一种众所周知的类金属，通过改变水稻的根系结构来限制其生长和生产力。由于砷胁迫下的根系结构（RSA）靶向WRKY转录因子（TFs）及其相互作用伙伴，本研究旨在更好地理解铁依赖性的根系结构动态及其在此过程中的参与。在此，我们分析了砷和铁（单独或联合）对水培生长的12日龄水稻根系的影响。我们的研究表明，在Ratna和Lalat品种中，向铁中添加砷改变了OsWRKY71的表达，并改善了水稻根系的形态和解剖结构。砷+铁处理也体现了生化参数的变化。与对照相比，OsWRKY71在两个品种中均表现出上调（单独铁和砷+铁条件）和下调（砷胁迫）。改善的根系解剖结构和根系氧化能力表明，Lalat品种在砷+铁处理期间诱导OsWRKY71以促进根系结构更好发育的能力优于Ratna品种。此外，OsWRKY71在其启动子区域中揭示了赤霉素响应性顺式调控元件（GAREs）的存在，表明OsWRKY71参与赤霉素途径。分子对接显示OsWRKY71和SLR1（DELLA蛋白）正相互作用，这支持了铁通过赤霉素途径调控OsWRKY71以改变砷胁迫水稻根系结构的假说。
